capabilities: Compile multiple notes into a single editable flow note
Define flows from Dataview queries, folders, tags, properties, or bookmark groups
Sync edits between flows and their source notes in both directions
Rebuild flows automatically or on demand
Export flows as plain notes with tracking UUIDs stripped
extras: Classic flows duplicate source content in a hidden system folder; author urges running backups, notes the plugin is not yet on the marketplace (install via BRAT or manually), and warns large flows make Obsidian sluggish.
motivation: The author wanted to work on differently composed excerpts of a vault without copy-pasting by hand, missing parts, or losing track of which excerpt has which edit.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view and edit several notes as one continuous Scrivenings-style document without manual copy-pasting.

relations.evidence: The Dataview plugin needs to be installed in order for textFlow to work.

summary: Dynamic document builder that compiles multiple notes into a single editable flow and syncs changes back to the source notes.
